11.name: Global Junior Talents
11.overview: Ma Ka Pa kicks off a musical night From Sejal's melody to Denin's standing ovation Later , Saurabi's shocking Tamil debut, witness the rising stars of Senior Singers.

11.name: A Grand Musical Beginning
11.overview: A musical celebration of talented little masters begins with an exciting introductory round. Stay tuned to watch the junior singers win hearts with their magical voices!

11.name: The Selection Showdown
11.overview: Stay tuned as young contestants deliver breathtaking performances in the Top Twenty selection. As emotions soar, some secure their spots while others are moved to the waiting list.

11.name: Top 20 Musical Stars
11.overview: Laya, Sree Vardhini, Aryan and Vishnu enter the Top 20. Visually impaired Sarveshwaran scores 100 percent and touches hearts. Later, Ma Ka Pa welcomes 17 selected contestants.

11.name: Super Singer Juniors Battle
11.overview: Ma Ka Pa and Priyanka host as juniors shine. Vaishnavan and Aryan join Imman's team, judges fight over Lenin Berno until he chooses Anuradha, and Sejal delivers a hit solo.

11.name: Singing Battle Heats Up
11.overview: The little masters' singing battle grows intense as judges fiercely compete with stars to win them. Watch the junior singers secure their places on the judges' teams!

11.name: Team-building in Full Swing!
11.overview: Judges enjoy energetic acts by Vinu and Mithran. Imman wins Jeanna for his team, while Anuradha bags Surabhi after a standing ovation.

11.name: The Teams are Ready!
11.overview: Contestants impress with heartfelt performances in the selection round. Anuradha and Imman form strong teams with talented singers for the upcoming weeks.

11.name: Grand Musical Night
11.overview: Ma Ka Pa and Priyanka welcome special judge T. Rajendran to the show. Later, Sarveshwaran overcomes the odds with a stellar performance, making mentor Imman proud.

11.name: A Colourful Show by Little Stars
11.overview: The stage comes alive as little singers showcase vibrant getups in a fancy dress competitive round. Watch as judges are left amazed by their delightful performances.

11.name: Exciting Fancy Dress Round!
11.overview: The fancy dress round turns more exciting as Madonna Sebastian joins the show, delivering stunning performances alongside the little stars. Stay tuned for the fun!

11.name: Soulful Singing to Big Hugs
11.overview: Judges and hosts join the kids for an unforgettable night of Kathakali dance, triple buzzers, and elite singing. Ma Ka Pa and Priyanka close the show on a comedic note.

11.name: Soulful Duets Ignite the Stage
11.overview: Musical magic ignites as Vijay Yesudas and Manchari join the judges. Experience the heartfelt duets, standing ovations, and mesmerising judge-contestant collaborations.

11.name: Sensational Duets Rock the Stage!
11.overview: An energetic night of folk, nostalgia, and comedy! Ma Ka Pa pairs up for a fun duet and stirs up the stage, while top duets earn judges buzzers and gift vouchers.

11.name: Pattikada vs Pattanama
11.overview: The energetic Pattikada vs Pattanama round leaves the judges completely thrilled. Unmissable musical acts and fun moments make this a spectacular night.

11.name: The Battle for the Trophy
11.overview: Sensational performances earn standing ovations and high praise from the judges. Ma Ka Pa brings the laughs before a tense Pattikada and Pattanama's trophy reveal.

11.name: The Meaningful Melodies Round
11.overview: The judges and lyricist Pa. Vijay welcome a round of meaningful lyrics, featuring spectacular buzzer-winning acts, valuable guidance, and deeply emotional moments.

11.name: A Night of Melodic Surprises
11.overview: A night of high energy music earns standing ovations. Pa. Vijay recalls lyricist Vaali, while emotional hugs, special gifts, and family surprises fill the stage.

11.name: A Soulful Tribute to Bharathiraja
11.overview: A heartfelt tribute to Bharathiraja celebrates his legendary contribution to Tamil cinema with soulful performances. The episode honours his timeless legacy with special guests.

11.name: A Musical Salute to a Legend!
11.overview: Host duo Ma Ka Pa and Priyanka open with a Bharathiraja tribute.Contestants overcome errors, delivering emotional, buzzer-winning acts that earn standing ovations.

11.name: K. Bhagyaraj's Cinematic Legacy
11.overview: A grand tribute to K. Bhagyaraj unfolds with special guest Livingston. Soulful performances celebrating S. Janaki's timeless melodies leave the audience spellbound.

11.name: Golden Tunes of K. Bhagyaraj
11.overview: Ma Ka Pa invites R. Sundarajan to honour K. Bhagyaraj. The juniors enact a movie scene, and the judges award buzzers as the singers deliver spectacular, mesmerising performances.

11.name: Celebrating S. Janaki's Legacy
11.overview: Celebrating S. Janaki's legacy, the stage comes alive with emotional performances and a breathtaking medley. Heartfelt memories and tributes make the celebration even more special.

11.name: A Magical Evening Of Melodies
11.overview: Seniors honour the legendary singer with flawless acts, magical duets and buzzers. Standing ovations follow, while judges and guests team up for memorable musical mashups.

11.name: Junior's One-on-One Face Off
11.overview: Junior Singers enter an intense one-on-one battle round. Engaging games ignite every face off, and winners claim amazing gifts from the Gift Room in this thrilling competition.

11.name: Fun Fuels Fierce Competition
11.overview: Fun-filled games, and the arrival of Teddy and King Kong fill the competitive round with excitement. The kids delight singer Chitra with a special birthday celebration.

11.name: Aadi Thiruvizha Special
11.overview: Actress Radha joins Aadi Thiruvizha for a grand Divine Round. Meanwhile, the contestants captivate the crowd with divine acts and expert judge feedback.

11.name: The Little Stars' Divine Melodies
11.overview: The little stars enchant the stage with soulful devotional songs, vividly bringing the Gods' presence alive. Tune in to witness the divine glory of the Aadi Thiruvizha round.

11.name: Heartwarming Tributes to Loved Ones
11.overview: The dedication round celebrates inspiring bonds through heartfelt songs and meaningful gifts. Contestants honour their loved ones with emotional performances and gratitude.

11.name: Heartfelt Tributes Fill the Stage
11.overview: Love and gratitude take centre stage in the dedication round. Contestants pour their emotions into heartfelt performances while competing for Golden Voice of the Week.

11.name: Fun Max Cinematic Round
11.overview: Movie magic meets unstoppable fun in the Cinema Round with hilarious recreations and spectacular singing acts by junior singers. Tune in for a fun-filled cinematic celebration!

11.name: Musical Magic and Comedy Mayhem
11.overview: A power-packed night of soulful music, side-splitting comedy, and emotional acts. Judges share warm praise and expert guidance for every stunning performance.

11.name: Rock and Roll Extravaganza
11.overview: Special guest Shruti Haasan lights up the stage, getting emotional over a special clip. Thrilling performances win buzzers, while judge Chithra mesmerises all.

11.name: Retro Magic Takes Over the Stage
11.overview: Retro classics come alive in the Rock 'n' Roll round through energetic performances. A special celebration honours Shruti Haasan's journey with a montage of her memorable moments.

11.name: Rocking Medleys Blend with Emotion
11.overview: An emotional family reunion for Saurabi and Shruthi's rocking performance elevates the Rock 'n' Roll round. Retro medleys from Super Singer stars steal the spotlight.

11.name: Celebrating Deva's Musical Legacy
11.overview: Ma Ka Pa and Priyanka welcome Deva for a special round filled with top performances and custom lyrics. Mani and Band receive a lesson, while Chithra and Deva share glowing praise.

11.name: A Soulful Tribute to Deva's Music
11.overview: Judges are spellbound as Little Stars deliver energetic renditions of Deva's hits. Tears of joy follow as Deva's musical troupe surprises him with a pleasant entry on stage.

11.name: A Magical Top 10 Moon Night
11.overview: Priyanka and Ma Ka Pa host the Top 10 Moon event. As guest stars join the fun, powerful singing acts impress the judges and lead to touching family moments.

11.name: A Night of Unforgettable Music
11.overview: Special guest Venkat Prabhu visits for a magical night of music! Featuring Golden Moon honours, heartwarming parent tributes, and stellar duets with legendary singers.

11.name: Race to Finale Showdown!
11.overview: The Race to Finale begins with the top 10 contestants competing for the Golden Buzzer and belt. As the competition heats up, tune in to see who secures the ticket to the finale!

11.name: The Battle for Finale Tickets
11.overview: As the competition intensifies, contestants race towards the finale while judges identify mistakes and mark corrections. With stakes rising, contestants strive to prove themselves.

11.name: Race to Finale Phase 2 Begins
11.overview: The contestants turn up the energy in Race to Finale Phase 2, battling it out for the finale ticket. Fuelled by confidence, they push ahead with renewed determination.

11.name: Stars Unleash Magic
11.overview: Hosts Ma Ka Pa and Priyanka welcome team Anbil Avan to The Race 2 Finale Phase 2. Amid stunning acts, fun music lessons, and dancing, stars honor the first finalist!

11.name: Race to Finale Phase 3!
11.overview: The Race to Finale Phase 3 continues with the contestants delivering power-packed performances. Tune in as one singer earns the Golden Buzzer and becomes the second finalist!

11.name: Who Advances in the Finale Race?
11.overview: Strong performances make the Race to the Finale Phase Three round unforgettable. Yet the judges' decision remains a mystery, building suspense over who will move forward next.

11.name: Musical Magic Takes the Stage
11.overview: Favourite musicians elevate the Juniors' battle for the last finale ticket. With judges impressed by the musical brilliance, anticipation grows as the final spot awaits its winner.

11.name: Duets and Final Dreams
11.overview: Judges Chithra and Imman perform a splendid duet as the battle for the third finalist spot intensifies. Romantic duets, stunning acts keep the judges and the audience captivated.

11.name: Super Singer Wildcard Round
11.overview: Super Singer's wildcard round brings comebacks, golden buzzers, and touching stories. A standout singer moves the judges to secure the fourth finalist spot.

11.name: Wildcard Action Rolls On
11.overview: The Wildcard Round brings fantastic performances that amaze the judges and earn their applause. Watch as the competition unfolds with more surprises and thrilling moments!

11.name: A Musical Salute to Gaana King Deva
11.overview: The Godfather of Gaana music, Deva sir, is honoured through a musical tribute. Singers celebrate his extraordinary talent and legacy with soulful performances.

11.name: Electrifying Musical Showcase
11.overview: Tune in for sensational stage performances, heartfelt family moments, and moving tributes! Amid high talent and drama, watch contestants shine with incredible skill.

11.name: Diwali Musical Dhamaka
11.overview: Hosts Makapa and Priyanka welcome special guest Rimi Tomy for a sensational episode. The stage lights up with stunning musical acts, special surprises, and a fun trip for all.

11.name: An Emotional Pre Finale Night
11.overview: Teachers and friends shower the Super Singer Junior finalists with blessings on stage. Rimi Tomy and Imman entertain the audience before an emotional AV leaves everyone moved.

overview: Super Singer Junior is a reality TV show since February 2007 hosted by Vijay TV. It is a singing talent hunt for the children of age group 6–15. This is the junior version of the Super Singer show.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: The hunt for the next Super Singer begins with an exciting panel of judges! Extraordinary young talents compete against each other for the coveted title.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: Twenty rising stars take centre stage on Super Singer. With daring rounds and legendary mentors, every note tells a story. Who will claim the coveted crown?
